# Reference

Generated from the code: environment variables, CLI options, helper scripts and the
wiki index. Regenerate with `make wiki-reference`; the Docs check fails if this page
is out of date.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Section | Default in `env.example` | What it controls |
|---|---|---|---|
| OPENAI_API_KEY | LLM providers | sk-... | — |
| ANTHROPIC_API_KEY | LLM providers | sk-ant-... | — |
| DUE_DIL_MODEL | LLM providers | gpt-4o | Which model to use by default: "gpt-4o" or "claude-3-5-sonnet" |
| LLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY | LlamaParse (PDF -> Markdown) | llx-... | — |
| TAVILY_API_KEY | Tavily (web search) | tvly-... | — |
| LANGSMITH_TRACING | LangSmith tracing (optional) | true | The SDK reads the LANGSMITH_* names; the older LANGCHAIN_* ones still work as aliases. |
| LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT | LangSmith tracing (optional) | https://api.smith.langchain.com | — |
| LANGSMITH_API_KEY | LangSmith tracing (optional) | lsv2_... | — |
| LANGSMITH_PROJECT | LangSmith tracing (optional) | DueDil.Agent | — |
| LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 | LangSmith tracing (optional) | true | Only needed for keys scoped to more than one workspace (the workspace UUID). |
| LANGCHAIN_ENDPOINT | LangSmith tracing (optional) | https://api.smith.langchain.com | — |
| LANGCHAIN_API_KEY | LangSmith tracing (optional) | lsv2_... | — |
| LANGCHAIN_PROJECT | LangSmith tracing (optional) | DueDil.Agent | — |

The app runs without any of these: with no LLM key it falls back to the rule-based
offline agents, and with no `LLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` the PDF parser degrades to `pypdf`.
Commented-out entries in `env.example` are optional advanced switches.

## CLI options

`python -m app.cli <deck.pdf> [url] [options]`

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `deck` | path to the pitch deck PDF |
| `url` | startup website URL |
| `-o`, `--out` | output PDF path (default: data/<company>_memo.pdf) |
| `--md` | also write the raw Markdown memo here |
| `--json` | dump the full final state to this JSON file |
| `--model` | override the LLM id (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet) |
| `--quiet` | only print the final memo |
| `--version` | — |

| Script | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/capture_demo.py` | Capture screenshots and a walkthrough video of the Streamlit UI. |
| `scripts/coverage_badge.py` | Generate a shields.io-style coverage badge from the ``.coverage`` data file. |
| `scripts/demo_offline.py` | Run DueDil.Agent end-to-end with no API keys and no network. |
| `scripts/demo_offline_ui.py` | Launch the Streamlit UI in offline demo mode (no API keys, no network). |
| `scripts/import_probe.py` | Staged import probe: find which import kills a hosted deployment. |
| `scripts/langsmith_key_check.py` | Диагностика ключа LangSmith: к какому инстансу он привязан и работает ли он. |
| `scripts/make_banner.py` | Generate the 1280x640 GitHub social-preview banner (PNG + SVG). |
| `scripts/make_example_decks.py` | Generate example pitch decks for five real IT companies, from public facts only. |
| `scripts/make_run_stop_doc.py` | Build the personal "how to run / how to stop" walkthrough as a Word document. |
| `scripts/make_sample_deck.py` | Generate a small synthetic pitch-deck PDF for testing DueDil.Agent. |
| `scripts/personal-sync.sh` | Copy the files that git does NOT carry between the Linux server and a laptop. |
| `scripts/project.ps1` | > |
| `scripts/project.sh` | DueDil.Agent — start/stop helper for Linux, macOS and WSL. |
